text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To think I couldn't even make the board...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The racing world is harsh." Even as 
someone who studied history, I understood 
that, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list:
Failures and setbacks will fuel your 
future growth.

I need to get my head back in the game 
too...!
I need to refocus and brace myself too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: 失敗や挫折も、今後の糧になるよ
俺も気を引き締め直さないと……！
私も気を引き締め直さないと……！

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: 失敗や挫折も、今後の糧になるよ
俺も気を引き締め直さないと……！
私も気を引き締め直さないと……！

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: それも歴史が証明しているだろう？
それも歴史が証明しているでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To overcome adversity and bloom 
brilliantly once more—that is the drama I 
will bring to life...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Chrono Genesis's quietly burning eyes, 
I saw undeniable resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis slaps her own cheeks with 
both hands. A crisp, dry smack echoed 
out."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I can't just sit around 
moping either.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If I am to keep competing against such 
outstanding rivals from now on... I cannot 
stop; I must keep moving forward—"
choice_data_list:
Next time, the two of us will leave our 
mark on history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: 次こそふたりで、歴史に爪痕を残そう！

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will see it through without 
fail...!
